title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
authors: Elizaveta Semenyakina, Ivan Snegirev, Mikhail Kiselev, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Artem Lykov, Hajira Amjad, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

tldr.zh: 在固定 VLA 外增加执行监督 Agent，用指位偏差和电机负载推断接触，在抓握支撑不足时暂停后续运动、逐指修正闭合，并决定保持修正或交回 VLA 重试，无需额外触觉传感器或重新训练 VLA。
tldr.en: AgenticTactileVLA wraps a fixed VLA with an execution-supervision Agent that infers contact from finger-motion mismatch and motor effort, pauses subsequent motion and corrects individual finger closure when grasp support is insufficient, then retains the correction or returns control to the VLA for retry, without extra tactile sensors or VLA retraining.

evaluation_scope.zh: 基础 GR00T-N1.6-3B 经遥操作示范微调后固定，读取图像、指令、机器人状态与实测指位，输出身体运动 token 和六通道手部位置目标。外部、无需训练的有状态监督层在闭合末期依据指令与实际指位的运动偏差判断支撑不足，调整时再结合电机负载变化逐指补闭合；暂停的仅是身体运动参考推进，稳定控制保持运行。通过支撑判据则保持修正手形，否则释放手部接管，由后续 VLA 指令决定重新张手和接近；释放接管本身不命令张手。权重不在线更新，修正后的实测手形进入下一轮观测。闭合前可由语言提示或 VLM 选择预设限流柔顺模式，VLM 不生成控制参数。本体反馈是接触证据，不是标定接触力，也没有新增触觉硬件。Unitree G1＋BrainCo Revo2，5 个训练外物体、每物体 15 次配对试验，共享 60 秒／最多 3 次接近预算，完成率由 61.3% 提升到 84.0%（无条件补闭合为 72.0%）。柔顺分支仅验证闭合与保持时的物体完整性，未验证自主搬运；未证明跨手型或跨 VLA 通用。
evaluation_scope.en: The base GR00T-N1.6-3B is fixed after teleoperation fine-tuning. It reads images, instructions, robot state and measured hand positions, and outputs body-motion tokens and six-channel hand-position targets. An external, nonlearned stateful supervisor detects insufficient support at terminal closure from commanded-versus-measured finger motion; motor-effort deviations additionally guide per-finger adjustment. Only body-reference progression pauses, while stabilization remains active. Passing the support criterion retains the corrected configuration; otherwise the hand override is released so subsequent VLA commands can reopen and re-approach. Releasing the override does not itself command reopening. Weights remain unchanged; corrected measured hand positions enter subsequent observations. Before closure, language cues or a VLM can select a predefined current-limited compliant mode; the VLM does not generate controller parameters. Proprioceptive feedback is contact evidence rather than calibrated force, with no extra tactile hardware. Unitree G1 with BrainCo Revo2 is evaluated on five held-out objects, 15 matched trials per object, with a shared 60-second/three-approach budget. Completion rises from 61.3% to 84.0% (72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall). The compliant branch evaluates object integrity during closure and holding, not autonomous transport; cross-hand and cross-VLA generality are not established.
